name: Craft Vessel
description:
Casting time: 10 minutes.

You transform a mundane object into a magic vessel capable of capturing and holding a creature. The object may be anything with an opening that can be sealed - a glass phial, a seashell, an iron flask, a wooden box, etc. You adorn the object with special components of your choosing.

The overall Keeping of the object and components determines the vessel’s quality. If you spend...

  • 1 treasure (Modest): Standard Vessel

  • 2 treasure (Comfortable): Great Vessel

  • 3 treasure (Prosperous): Ultra Vessel

  • 4 treasure (Opulent): Maestro Vessel

When you use a vessel for your Capture ability, subtract the vessel's keeping from the creature's Challenge when determining whether it is captured.

Describe the vessel you create.
